why: phase0_field_values.industry is absent for both live tenants; verticals is
declared for both. Without a mapping, the resolver returned the declared
vertical string verbatim ('Crypto exchange (retail)'), which is not one of
the 29 industry_styles handles, so registry_handle was always None and the
industry was effectively unresolved on every real build.
This file is the mapping, as DATA: an operator-authored, versioned decision
that is auditable and diffable, never a runtime guess. A resolution that
comes through this table is recorded as source 'derived-from-verticals' and
carries derived_from (the declared string) plus mapping_version, so it can
never be mistaken for the tenant's own declaration. A vertical with no row
here is NOT defaulted — the build refuses (exit 3, NOT_MEASURED).
key_rule: keys are the declared vertical string slugified: lowercased, every run of non-alphanumeric characters collapsed to '-', leading/trailing '-' stripped

crypto-exchange-retail.grounding: a retail crypto exchange is a consumer financial-technology product; 'fintech' is an industry_styles handle

wealth-management-advisory-b2b2c.grounding: wealth management and investment advisory are licensed activities; 'regulated-finance' is an industry_styles handle

crypto-infrastructure-as-a-service-b2b-f.grounding: the declaration names itself 'B2B fintech and banking'

stablecoins.grounding: a stablecoin issuer is a financial-technology product

fiat-on-off-ramps.grounding: fiat on/off-ramp is a payments/financial-technology service

crypto-asset-gateway.grounding: a crypto asset gateway is a payments/financial-technology service
